functions.name: prg32_ticks_ms
functions.notes: Return the wrapping 32-bit millisecond clock; compare elapsed differences, not absolute deadlines.

functions.name: prg32_input_read
functions.notes: Return the PRG32_BTN_* mask of every pressed input: physical buttons, QEMU keys, and remote device-protocol keys.

functions.name: prg32_input_read_player
functions.notes: Return the button mask of one player; player 2 reads as 0 on a single-controller console.

functions.name: prg32_input_read_menu
functions.notes: Return the button mask used by resident menus, limited to the defined PRG32_BTN_* bits.

functions.name: prg32_controller_read
functions.notes: Return the raw combined controller mask before any per-player filtering.

functions.name: prg32_buzzer_tone
functions.notes: Play a PWM tone of hz for ms with the given duty cycle on the buzzer; QEMU uses the nearest MIDI note.

functions.name: prg32_audio_note
functions.notes: Play one note asynchronously on a channel with an instrument, volume, and duration in milliseconds.

functions.name: prg32_buzzer_play_notes
functions.notes: Play a blocking sequence of frequency/duration notes on the buzzer.

functions.name: prg32_buzzer_sample_u8
functions.notes: Play unsigned 8-bit PCM centred on 128 at sample_rate; blocks for the duration of the call.

functions.name: prg32_audio_init
functions.notes: Initialize the audio runtime; the resident firmware normally owns this call.

functions.name: prg32_audio_shutdown
functions.notes: Stop the audio runtime and release its output.

functions.name: prg32_audio_get_mode
functions.notes: Return PRG32_AUDIO_MODE_MONO or PRG32_AUDIO_MODE_STEREO.

functions.name: prg32_audio_play_sample
functions.notes: Play a registered sample centred; return the voice channel or a negative error.

functions.name: prg32_audio_play_sample_pan
functions.notes: Play a registered sample with a pan of -128 (left) to 127 (right); return the channel or a negative error.

functions.name: prg32_audio_stop_channel
functions.notes: Stop one voice channel.

functions.name: prg32_audio_stop_all
functions.notes: Stop every voice channel.

functions.name: prg32_audio_note_on
functions.notes: Start a PCM or synth instrument note on a channel until note_off.

functions.name: prg32_audio_note_on_pan
functions.notes: Start a PCM or synth instrument note with pan on a channel until note_off.

functions.name: prg32_audio_note_off
functions.notes: Stop a PCM note or begin the release of a synth note on a channel.

functions.name: prg32_audio_notes
functions.notes: Play a blocking sequence of MIDI notes on one channel; use tracks for asynchronous music.

functions.name: prg32_audio_play_track
functions.notes: Start a registered tracker stream.

functions.name: prg32_audio_stop_track
functions.notes: Stop the tracker stream.

functions.name: prg32_audio_set_tempo
functions.notes: Set the tracker tempo in beats per minute.

functions.name: prg32_audio_set_master_volume
functions.notes: Set the global audio volume.

functions.name: prg32_audio_set_channel_volume
functions.notes: Set the volume of one voice channel.

functions.name: prg32_audio_set_channel_pan
functions.notes: Set the pan of one voice channel, -128 (left) to 127 (right).

functions.name: prg32_wifi_start_mode
functions.notes: Start Wi-Fi in the configured mode; return 0 on success. Cartridges must keep an offline path.

functions.name: prg32_wifi_current_mode
functions.notes: Return the active Wi-Fi mode.

functions.name: prg32_wifi_current_ip
functions.notes: Return the current IP address as text, owned by the firmware.

functions.name: prg32_wifi_current_ssid
functions.notes: Return the current network name, owned by the firmware.

functions.name: prg32_wifi_setup_requested
functions.notes: Return nonzero while the setup button is held; 0 when the profile has no setup button.

functions.name: prg32_wifi_setup_run
functions.notes: Run the resident Wi-Fi setup screens; return 0 on success.

functions.name: prg32_multiplayer_init
functions.notes: Prepare the Wi-Fi multiplayer frame exchange.

functions.name: prg32_multiplayer_available
functions.notes: Return true when multiplayer networking can be used.

functions.name: prg32_multiplayer_join
functions.notes: Join a multiplayer room with a timeout in milliseconds; return 0 on success.

functions.name: prg32_multiplayer_leave
functions.notes: Leave the current multiplayer room; return 0 on success.

functions.name: prg32_multiplayer_tick
functions.notes: Exchange pending multiplayer frames; call once per update.

functions.name: prg32_multiplayer_set_local_state
functions.notes: Publish this player's position and two state words to peers; return 0 on success.

functions.name: prg32_multiplayer_set_input
functions.notes: Publish this player's input mask to peers; return 0 on success.

functions.name: prg32_multiplayer_get_peer_count
functions.notes: Return the number of known peers.

functions.name: prg32_multiplayer_get_peer
functions.notes: Copy the state of peer index into caller storage; return 0 on success.

functions.name: prg32_cart_stored_count
functions.notes: Return the number of valid cartridges stored in slots.

functions.name: prg32_cart_get_slot_info
functions.notes: Copy the header information of one slot into caller storage; return 0 on success.

functions.name: prg32_cart_select_slot
functions.notes: Request loading the cartridge in a slot; return 0 on success.

functions.name: prg32_cart_default_slot
functions.notes: Return the saved default slot, or a negative value when none is saved.

functions.name: prg32_cart_set_default_slot
functions.notes: Save the default slot; return 0 on success.

functions.name: prg32_cart_select_default
functions.notes: Request loading the default slot; return 0 on success.

functions.name: prg32_console_clear
functions.notes: Clear the 40x25 text console.

functions.name: prg32_console_putc
functions.notes: Write one character to the text console.

functions.name: prg32_console_write
functions.notes: Write a NUL-terminated string to the text console.

functions.name: prg32_console_hex32
functions.notes: Write a 32-bit value as hexadecimal to the text console.

functions.name: prg32_gfx_clear
functions.notes: Clear the viewport to an RGB565 color.

functions.name: prg32_gfx_present
functions.notes: Publish the completed back buffer to the display.

functions.name: prg32_gfx_set_fullscreen
functions.notes: Enable or disable fullscreen drawing; mainly a resident firmware service.

functions.name: prg32_gfx_fullscreen_enabled
functions.notes: Return nonzero when fullscreen drawing is enabled.

functions.name: prg32_gfx_pixel
functions.notes: Draw one clipped RGB565 pixel.

functions.name: prg32_gfx_rect
functions.notes: Fill a clipped rectangle with an RGB565 color; non-positive sizes draw nothing.

functions.name: prg32_gfx_text8
functions.notes: Draw a string in the 8x8 font with RGB565 foreground and background colors.

functions.name: prg32_gfx_snapshot_row_rgb565
functions.notes: Copy one screen row of RGB565 pixels; return the count copied or a negative error.

functions.name: prg32_band_set_mode
functions.notes: Set what a status band above or below the viewport shows.

functions.name: prg32_band_mode
functions.notes: Return the mode of a status band.

functions.name: prg32_band_mode_name
functions.notes: Return the display name of a band mode.

functions.name: prg32_band_set_text
functions.notes: Set the text of a status band; the runtime copies it.

functions.name: prg32_band_set_game_info
functions.notes: Set the game information text shown in the bands.

functions.name: prg32_band_log
functions.notes: Append a message to the log band.

functions.name: prg32_band_set_colors
functions.notes: Set the RGB565 foreground and background colors of a band.

functions.name: prg32_band_use_default_colors
functions.notes: Restore the default colors of a band.

functions.name: prg32_band_load_config
functions.notes: Load the saved band configuration; mainly a resident firmware service.

functions.name: prg32_band_save_config
functions.notes: Save the band configuration to flash; mainly a resident firmware service.

functions.name: prg32_splash_draw
functions.notes: Draw a title and subtitle splash screen in the given colors.

functions.name: prg32_splash_show
functions.notes: Show a splash screen for duration_ms, then return.

functions.name: prg32_splash_draw_game
functions.notes: Draw a game title splash screen in the given colors.

functions.name: prg32_splash_show_game
functions.notes: Show a game title splash screen for duration_ms, then return.

functions.name: prg32_splash_show_default
functions.notes: Show the default PRG32 splash screen.

functions.name: prg32_debug_overlay_draw
functions.notes: Draw the input and frame debug overlay at a position when enabled.

functions.name: prg32_input_wait_released
functions.notes: Block until every button in mask has been released.

functions.name: prg32_keyboard_init
functions.notes: Initialize an on-screen keyboard that edits caller-owned text storage.

functions.name: prg32_keyboard_update
functions.notes: Apply one frame of input to the keyboard; return nonzero when editing completes.

functions.name: prg32_keyboard_draw
functions.notes: Draw the on-screen keyboard at a position.

functions.name: prg32_text_input
functions.notes: Run a modal on-screen text entry; return the text length, or -1 when cancelled.

functions.name: prg32_tile_clear
functions.notes: Clear the tile screen to an RGB565 color.

functions.name: prg32_tile_define
functions.notes: Define an 8x8 one-bit tile with RGB565 foreground and background colors.

functions.name: prg32_tile_put
functions.notes: Place a tile ID at tile coordinates.

functions.name: prg32_tile_present
functions.notes: Draw the tile screen and publish it.

functions.name: prg32_playfield_clear
functions.notes: Fill a playfield layer with one tile ID.

functions.name: prg32_playfield_put
functions.notes: Place a tile ID in a playfield layer.

functions.name: prg32_playfield_get
functions.notes: Return the tile ID at a playfield position, or 0 outside the map.

functions.name: prg32_playfield_scroll
functions.notes: Set the scroll position of a layer in pixels.

functions.name: prg32_playfield_scroll_by
functions.notes: Move the scroll position of a layer by a pixel delta.

functions.name: prg32_playfield_parallax
functions.notes: Set the Q8 parallax factors of a layer; PRG32_PARALLAX_1X follows the camera exactly.

functions.name: prg32_playfield_camera
functions.notes: Set the camera position in pixels.

functions.name: prg32_playfield_camera_x
functions.notes: Return the camera x position in pixels.

functions.name: prg32_playfield_camera_y
functions.notes: Return the camera y position in pixels.

functions.name: prg32_playfield_draw
functions.notes: Draw one layer; transparent_zero skips tile ID 0.

functions.name: prg32_playfield_draw_dual
functions.notes: Draw both playfield layers with parallax.

functions.name: prg32_playfield_present
functions.notes: Draw the configured playfield composition and publish it.

functions.name: prg32_platform_tile_flags
functions.notes: Set the collision flags of a tile ID.

functions.name: prg32_platform_tile_flags_get
functions.notes: Return the collision flags of a tile ID.

functions.name: prg32_platform_tile_at
functions.notes: Return the tile ID under a pixel position in a layer.

functions.name: prg32_platform_solid_at
functions.notes: Return nonzero when the pixel position in a layer is solid.

functions.name: prg32_platform_actor_init
functions.notes: Initialize a platform actor with a layer, position, and size.

functions.name: prg32_platform_actor_move
functions.notes: Move an actor by a delta with collision; return PRG32_PLATFORM_* contacts.

functions.name: prg32_platform_actor_step
functions.notes: Move an actor from an input mask with jump and gravity; return PRG32_PLATFORM_* contacts.

functions.name: prg32_platform_camera_follow
functions.notes: Move the camera to keep an actor inside a deadzone.

functions.name: prg32_sprite_hitbox
functions.notes: Return nonzero when two half-open rectangles intersect.

functions.name: prg32_sprite_draw_8x8
functions.notes: Draw an 8x8 one-bit sprite with RGB565 foreground and background colors.

functions.name: prg32_sprite_draw_16x16
functions.notes: Draw a 16x16 RGB565 sprite.

functions.name: prg32_sprite_anim_frame
functions.notes: Return the animation frame index for a time, frame count, and frame duration.

functions.name: prg32_sprite_draw_frame
functions.notes: Draw one frame of an RGB565 sprite strip, skipping the transparent color.

functions.name: prg32_sprite_anim_init
functions.notes: Initialize an animated RGB565 sprite descriptor.

functions.name: prg32_sprite_anim_update
functions.notes: Advance an animated sprite to the given time.

functions.name: prg32_sprite_anim_draw
functions.notes: Draw the current frame of an animated sprite.

functions.name: prg32_score_submit
functions.notes: Store a score for a game and player; return 0 on success.

functions.name: prg32_sprite_draw_24x24
functions.notes: Draw a 24x24 RGB565 sprite.

functions.name: prg32_score_player_get
functions.notes: Copy the current player name into caller storage; return 0 on success.

functions.name: prg32_score_player_set
functions.notes: Set the current player name; return 0 on success.

functions.name: prg32_score_player_prompt
functions.notes: Ask for the player name with the on-screen keyboard; return 0 on success.

functions.name: prg32_score_submit_current_player
functions.notes: Store a score for the current player; return 0 on success.

functions.name: prg32_score_sync_remote
functions.notes: Send stored scores to the score server; return 0 on success.

functions.name: prg32_score_count
functions.notes: Return the number of stored scores for a game.

functions.name: prg32_score_get
functions.notes: Copy one stored score of a game into caller storage; return 0 on success.

functions.name: prg32_scoreboard_show
functions.notes: Show the scoreboard of a game with a title.

functions.name: prg32_sprite_draw_indexed
functions.notes: Draw a packed indexed-color frame without expanding it in cartridge memory.

functions.name: prg32_sprite_draw_bitplanes
functions.notes: Draw a planar indexed-color frame without expanding it in cartridge memory.

functions.name: prg32_perf_now_us
functions.notes: Return the monotonic device timestamp in microseconds.

functions.name: prg32_perf_begin
functions.notes: Begin a versioned pluggable measurement suite.

functions.name: prg32_perf_case_begin
functions.notes: Begin a named case and allocate its temporary percentile workspace.

functions.name: prg32_perf_record
functions.notes: Record one caller-measured frame in the active case.

functions.name: prg32_perf_case_end
functions.notes: Aggregate the active case and release its temporary workspace.

functions.name: prg32_perf_end
functions.notes: Complete and publish the active suite.

functions.name: prg32_perf_abort
functions.notes: Abort safely and release all session workspace.

functions.name: prg32_perf_get_state
functions.notes: Copy versioned lifecycle and heap state.

functions.name: prg32_perf_get_summary
functions.notes: Copy the compact completed-run summary.

functions.name: prg32_palette_set
functions.notes: Set one system-palette entry from a native RGB565 value.

functions.name: prg32_palette_get
functions.notes: Read one system-palette entry as native RGB565.

functions.name: prg32_gfx_pixel_indexed
functions.notes: Draw one system-palette index.

functions.name: prg32_gfx_rect_indexed
functions.notes: Fill a clipped rectangle with one system-palette index.

functions.name: prg32_gfx_clear_indexed
functions.notes: Clear the game viewport to one system-palette index.

functions.name: prg32_random_number
functions.notes: Return a uniformly distributed integer between min and max inclusive; return min when max is less than or equal to min.

functions.name: prg32_multiplayer_local_player_id
functions.notes: Return the player ID the server confirmed for this session, or 0 before admission.

functions.name: prg32_input_axis_x
functions.notes: Return the horizontal stick position, -127 (left) to 127 (right), 0 at rest; without an analog stick LEFT/RIGHT give -127/127.

functions.name: prg32_input_axis_y
functions.notes: Return the vertical stick position, -127 (up) to 127 (down), 0 at rest; without an analog stick UP/DOWN give -127/127.

functions.name: prg32_input_axes_raw
functions.notes: Copy fresh 12-bit ADC readings (0 to 4095) of both axes; return 0, or -1 with 2048 when there is no analog stick.

functions.name: prg32_input_has_analog
functions.notes: Return 1 when an analog stick is sampled, 0 when axis values come from digital directions.
